content.short: LearnWeb3 provides web3 courses and a community for learning Web3 development.
content.description: LearnWeb3 is an educational platform designed for users at any skill level to grow and optimize their Web3 abilities. It offers a broad range of learning opportunities, including hands-on experiences like hackathons and structured guided paths that support steady progress. The platform also features a job board and spaces to discuss technical papers or collaborate on related events, fostering practical learning and active participation within the Web3 community.
